verified: The Decoder reports that four independent audit organizations, including Apollo Research and METR, have been granted on-site access to OpenAI's unreleased models, source code and training data — a first for the company.
unconfirmed: The identity of the other two auditors, the duration and terms of access, and whether any findings will be published; the arrangement rests on secondary reporting rather than a cited OpenAI announcement, and OpenAI's ability to redact or delay reports means the audits' independence has not been established.

verified: 据 The Decoder 报道，OpenAI 向包括 Apollo Research 和 METR 在内的四家独立机构开放了未发布模型、源代码和训练数据的直接访问权限，用于查找隐藏的不当行为和安全缺口。
unconfirmed: 这篇报道未引用 OpenAI 的原始公告；“首次”的说法、另外两家机构身份、审计启动时间与范围、报告是否公开，以及 OpenAI 删改或延迟报告的权限细节，均只来自该报道。

titles.en: OpenAI gives four independent auditors on-site access to unreleased models
titles.zh: OpenAI 首次允许四家独立机构现场审计未发布模型
